comment: Liquid Dynamics projectiles. cd_tissue is the drag coefficient of the round in soft-tissue simulant (10% ballistic gelatin) along its path, F = 1/2 rho Cd A v^2, for a round that does not yaw or expand. glass_impactor names the same round in the Glass Dynamics library so a host can hand pane strikes to that engine.

projectiles.name: 9 mm FMJ
projectiles.description: 124 grain full metal jacket from a pistol.

provenance.diameter_mm: published: C.I.P. 9 mm Luger bullet 9.01 mm
provenance.speed_ms: published: 124 gr FMJ from a 4 in barrel, 350-370 m/s (manufacturers' tables)
provenance.cd_tissue: estimated: non-yawing round-nose bullet in gelatin, 0.25-0.35 (Peters, J. Trauma 1990; Sturdivan 1978 drag fits)

provenance.speed_ms: published: 240 gr from a 6 in barrel, ~440 m/s
provenance.cd_tissue: estimated: flat meplat, more drag than round nose

projectiles.name: 7.62 x 51 mm ball
projectiles.description: 147 grain M80 ball from a rifle.

provenance.speed_ms: published: M80 from a 22 in barrel, ~840 m/s
provenance.cd_tissue: estimated: spitzer before it yaws; the yaw that real rifle rounds develop after 10-20 cm of tissue is not modelled
